minutes.headline: Select Board approved the EPG solar amendment and the Newen Chase Road power purchase agreement
minutes.summary: The board granted a change of manager and a one-day liquor license for the Lake View Club, a common victualler license, a one-day license for Conrad's, and a Class 2 auto license contingent on a CORI check. Town counsel walked through the EPG solar amendment and the Newen power purchase agreement, both approved, while the draft intermunicipal agreement with Townsend stayed a work in progress. The board also set policy workshop dates, heard committee and manager reports, and reappointed a registrar of voters.

what_happened.line: The Select Board approved an amendment to the power purchase agreement with EPG Solar after town counsel walked through it.
The board approved a separate power purchase agreement with Newen Capital Management for the Chase Road solar site.
The draft intermunicipal agreement with Townsend was discussed as a work in progress, and no vote on it is recorded in the minutes.
The board approved a Class 2 used car license at 39 Mass Ave, pending a CORI check, and a bond would be required.
The board set policies and procedures workshop dates, reappointed a registrar of voters, and put the Unitil rate case on next week's agenda.

why_it_matters: The two solar agreements set how the town is paid for solar power. One is a fixed price with an escalator, and the other is a percentage of the net metering credit value with no floor, so the savings on municipal electric costs depend on which terms hold.
The Unitil rate case could change residential electric bills, and the board may decide whether to file as an intervenor.
watch_next: Next week's Select Board agenda, which is to include the Unitil rate case and a possible intervenor filing.
Policies and procedures workshops, set for next week and July 30th.
